card.name: Inside co-administration and concomitantly
card.fires_on: Partway through words meaning given together, such as co-administration, coadministration and concomitantly, when a second drug is being discussed. Also fires on a few other spots just before 'with another drug' or 'at the same time'.

modes.description: The 'com' piece inside concomitantly before opioids.
